# A11y UI

> Accessibility-first React UI component library built for WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 Level AA & AAA compliance, screen reader support, keyboard navigation, and production design systems.

- Current package version: 2.3.2
- Package name: `@a11ypros/a11y-ui-components`
- For full API references, props, and code examples in a single document: [Full Documentation](https://ui.a11ypros.com/llms-full.txt)

## Overview & Guides

- [Home](https://ui.a11ypros.com/): Accessibility-first React component library homepage.
- [Getting Started](https://ui.a11ypros.com/getting-started): Installation, CSS token imports, and first usage guide.
- [Components Index](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components): Component catalog with summaries, examples, and Storybook links.
- [Theming & Tokens](https://ui.a11ypros.com/theming): Comprehensive 3-tier CSS custom property contract, light/dark mode, and live customizer.
- [Accessibility Guide](https://ui.a11ypros.com/accessibility): Core accessibility principles, WCAG criteria mapping, and assistive technology testing.
- [Custom Components](https://ui.a11ypros.com/custom-components): Custom WCAG 2.2 AA compliant component development for enterprise design systems.
- [Pro Tier](https://ui.a11ypros.com/pro): Upcoming enterprise components (DatePicker, DataGrid, Combobox, Rich Text Editor) and early access waitlist.

## Components

- [Accordion](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/accordion): WAI-ARIA collapsible disclosure pattern with keyboard arrow navigation.
- [Banner](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/banner): Status and alert notification banner with ARIA live regions and dismiss behavior.
- [Button](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/button): Interactive buttons with primary, secondary, ghost, danger variants and loading states.
- [Checkbox](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/checkbox): Accessible boolean choice and consent controls with custom keyboard-focusable indicator.
- [Data Table](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/table): Sortable tabular data grid with column header ARIA sorting and row selection.
- [Fieldset](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/fieldset): Semantic grouping for related form controls with legend context.
- [Input](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/input): Accessible single-line text and email fields with label association and error live regions.
- [Label](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/label): Semantic form labeling component with htmlFor association and required indicators.
- [Link](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/link): Accessible navigation and utility link variants with external indicator support.
- [Menu](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/menu): Dropdown action menus following the WAI-ARIA Menu Button pattern with roving focus, shortcut keys, and focus return.
- [Menubar](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/menubar): Desktop-style application menu bar following the WAI-ARIA Menubar pattern with roving tabindex and horizontal arrow navigation.
- [Modal](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/modal): Dialog overlay with automatic focus trapping, Escape key closing, and focus return.
- [Radio](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/radio): Mutually exclusive option groups wrapped with accessible fieldset semantics.
- [Select](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/select): Accessible dropdown select with keyboard navigation and option state management.
- [Switch](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/switch): Accessible toggle switch control implementing role="switch" and keyboard Space toggling.
- [Tabs](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/tabs): WAI-ARIA 1.2 compliant keyboard-navigable tab list and panels (ArrowLeft / ArrowRight).
- [Textarea](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/textarea): Multi-line text field with dynamic count and helper text.
- [Tooltip](https://ui.a11ypros.com/components/tooltip): Contextual popup descriptions with role="tooltip", aria-describedby, and Escape dismissal.
